title: drypetes laevigata
intro: Drypetes laevigata, commonly known as the smooth-stemmed drypetes, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
